generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal.
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class - IV and above Registration and the tenderer should submit the Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval.
Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act.

The Item rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per rates provided in prevailing Govt orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials curing, loading and unloading with all lead and lifts, labour, hire charges of machineries and equipment etc., complete and all other incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

All materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work. Department will not supply any materials.

Materials like bitumen, steel and cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the Quality Assurance Authority before commencement of the work.

All documents should be uploaded by the contractor is to be attested by the authorized notary or not below the rank of Executive Engineer and should be produced for verification at any stage of process as and when sought for .Failure to produce original documents leads to rejection of Tender.
Units, Rates and Prices shall be quoted by the tender in Indian Rupees only

For maintenance type of work the contractor should maintain the road for one year from the date of agreement & for constructive work the contractor should maintain the work during its defective liability period
Payment of EMD of Rs. 8,500.00 shall be through E payment

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incidents happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
